title: Race Result Finish Time Event Leaderboard
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=raceresult:event
| stats avg(finish_time_min) as avg_value max(finish_time_min) as peak_value count as sessions by event_name
| sort avg_value
description: Ranks event values by average and peak finish time in minutes, helping you see where race result finish time performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which event contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `event_name` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of event, average finish time in minutes, and peak finish time in minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which event areas give you the strongest race result finish time results.
